name: Survey tile in Gemini
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.9 degrees north of the ecliptic in Gemini, imaged by SPHEREx 19 times in 7 visits over 36 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 36 hours starting 2026-03-28, at wavelengths from 1.10 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
